The learning corner

Build your understanding.
One layer at a time.

A practical route through Lean 4, ELPI, and graph semantics. Free mini-books, short courses, and primary references, gathered in one place.

Learn the language.

Types, structures, propositions, and small proofs. Start with our Lean course, then open the official books.

Learn to reason.

Use λProlog to describe a search. Learn what binders and hypothetical assumptions make possible.

Bring a graph.

Choose a data model. Read its mini-book, run the project examples, and identify the claim you want to certify.
